findings.summary: Luna's 21-product catalog is incomplete. The live restaurant-issued homepage lists 37 current products: 35 frozen-baseline matches, two baseline-only products, and two current products missing from the frozen baseline.

Frozen records label several arrays as official ingredients, but the current official product descriptions only support narrow named-ingredient positives and establish neither complete arrays, negatives, may-contain values, nor cross-contact status.
No restaurant-issued may-contain, shared-equipment, or cross-contact statement was located on the complete official catalog or product page.

verifier.summary: Official live evidence verifies identity and a complete 37-product current catalog. Luna's 21-product partial extraction omitted 16 current baseline products and missed two current-only beverages; it also incorrectly retained two absent baseline products. Allergen evidence remains partial-positive-only where an official description explicitly names an ingredient, otherwise unavailable. No negatives, complete arrays, may-contain values, or cross-contact conclusion are supported.
